title: cyathea khasyana
intro: Cyathea khasyana, commonly known as the Khasi tree fern, is a species of tree fern that belongs to the family Cyatheaceae. It is native to the tropical regions of Asia and is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health. The health benefits of Cyathea khasyana include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which make it useful in treating various ailments such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and other phenolic compounds that exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties.
